2014.chapter_name: From the Diary of Anne Frank
2014.question: Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions given below in your own words:
2014.prashna: निम्नलिखित गद्यांश को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़ें और नीचे दिए गए प्रश्नों के उत्तर अपने शब्दों में दें:
2014.context: If you wish to be a writer, you must learn to develop your own point of view. All good writers make us see things in a different light. You may be writing about the same thing as your classmate, but your presentation must reflect your personality and individuality. There are so many interesting subjects you can write about in different forms but here we will try to attempt writing short stories. There is a good market for the following types: The humorous stories, the adventurous stories, the domestic stories, the mysteries and stories related to animals and strange experiences. Don't worry if the story turns out to be very short. Some of the very good stories are quite very short. Be very careful about the end of the story. So think of a plot-make points on how the story will progress and pen it down.

sub_questions.1: What does a reader do to be a writer?
sub_questions.2: What things must a successful writer keep in mind while writing a story?
sub_questions.3: Write any two types of stories which people like to read.
sub_questions.4: Find a phrase in the passage which means the same ‘to write’.

anuprashna.1: लेखक बनने के लिए पाठक को क्या करना चाहिए?
anuprashna.2: एक सफल लेखक को कहानी लिखते समय किन बातों का ध्यान रखना चाहिए?
anuprashna.3: किन्हीं दो प्रकार की कहानियों के नाम लिखिए जिन्हें लोग पढ़ना पसंद करते हैं।
anuprashna.4: गद्यांश में वह वाक्यांश ढूँढ़िए जिसका अर्थ 'लिखना' (to write) के समान हो।
